overview: PDF/CDF properties, mean/variance transformations, median, Poisson/normal facts.
coreConcept: CDF F(x)=P(X<=x) non-decreasing, 0 to 1. PDF integrates to 1.
hinglishExplanation: PDF se probability integral, CDF se P(a<X<=b)=F(b)-F(a). Y=aX+b: mean a mu + b, variance a^2 sigma^2. Poisson: mean=variance=lambda.
